msg: It seems as though different colour gnomes give you different numbers of points. They appear in the same colour pairs each time - pink and brown, orange and purple, green and blue and yellow and red. You can test which ones give more points - the best time to test is when it is x1 points. It seemed that gnomes which often gave high points would sometimes give low points. I think the number of points a gnome gives might have something to do with which side it is on. The colour pairs of gnomes keep switching sides. I did not manage to keep track of which side each gnome would give higher points but it might be something to try. Also, I wondered if there was a pattern in how many points a particular gnome awarded on successive appearances but I did not get to test this. There is not much time to think so generally if a particular gnome often gives high points when it is x5 it is best to go with that gnome.
